description: Apply ONE round of refinement to a pinned CRUD config. The pin is just the StructuredCrudConfig JSON you (the host) already hold — there is no server-side session. YOU apply the user's natural-language correction to produce the `revised` config, then call this tool with the `previous` (last-pinned) and `revised` JSON. It deterministically (1) validates `revised` against the authoritative schema and (2) returns a structured DIFF of what this round changed — fields added/removed, formtype/membership changes, actions, AND changed top-level blocks (dialogs / formLayout / tableOptions / buttons / columns / permissions / generation options), so a round that only adds an edit dialog or widens the form is not reported as "no change". If `revised` is invalid, you get the schema errors instead of a diff — fix and retry. Pass `revised` to generate_crud_from_config once you're happy. This tool does NOT call a model; the reasoning is yours.

previous.description: JSON string of the previously pinned config (omit for the first round).

revised.description: JSON string of the config after you applied the user's correction.

name: refine_config
